contentHtml:
Microsoft pushes OneDrive hard. It installs without asking, syncs without warning, and quietly rewires your folders in the background. If it has caused you grief, I will take it off properly and set you up with storage that stays out of your way. I help people across Stretton and Brisbane, onsite or remotely.

OneDrive does not always ask first

Windows quietly redirects your Desktop, Documents and Pictures folders into OneDrive, syncs in the background, and can leave you staring at "this file is online-only" icons instead of the files you thought were right there. It also chews through your free OneDrive storage without warning.

Removed properly, not just signed out

I fully unlink and uninstall OneDrive, move your files back into a genuine local folder structure, clear out the leftover startup entries and shortcuts, and set you up with whatever suits you instead, local storage, an external drive, or a different cloud provider if you still want one.

What is included

  • Unlinking and removal, OneDrive properly disconnected and uninstalled, not just paused.
  • Files restored locally, everything moved back where you expect to find it.
  • Clean-up, the startup entries, shortcuts and redirected-folder settings all put right.
  • Alternative storage, set up the way you actually want it.

If you would like a cloud option that you control, see my cloud backup and storage service, or to keep it all in-house, data backup and transfer.

Send me the details for a quote or call 0477 319 160, with no call-out fee anywhere on Stretton.
